# Membrane G711 FFmpeg Plugin v0.1.6 - Table of Contents

> Membrane G711 decoder and encoder based on FFmpeg

## Pages

- [Membrane G.711 FFmpeg plugin](https://membrane-g711-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-g711-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.G711.FFmpeg.Decoder](https://membrane-g711-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.G711.FFmpeg.Decoder.md): Membrane element that decodes audio in G711 format. It is backed by decoder from FFmpeg.
- [Membrane.G711.FFmpeg.Encoder](https://membrane-g711-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.G711.FFmpeg.Encoder.md): Membrane element that encodes raw audio frames to G711 format (A-law and μ-law are supported).
It is backed by encoder from FFmpeg.
- [Membrane.G711.FFmpeg.Parser](https://membrane-g711-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.G711.FFmpeg.Parser.md): This element is responsible for parsing audio in G711 format.
The Parser ensures that output buffers have whole samples.
The parser doesn't ensure that in each output buffer, there will be the same number of samples.
